courses.title: Interaction Design for Product Teams
courses.description: By the end of Interaction Design for Product Teams, you'll be able to apply interaction design confidently in Product Designer work, with a working sense of where api fundamentals fits alongside it. The course moves from core interaction design technique through a few applied exercises, with a lighter look at api fundamentals woven in throughout.
learning_outcomes: Applying interaction design to a real Product Designer scenario
Practicing interaction design through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to api fundamentals
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Accessibility in Practice
courses.description: Accessibility in Practice is a focused course on accessibility for people already working toward a Product Designer role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying accessibility on your own.
learning_outcomes: Applying accessibility to a real Product Designer scenario
Practicing accessibility through guided exercises
Building a short accessibility exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.description: Animation for Interfaces Fundamentals walks you through the basics of animation for interfaces, built for people new to Product Designer work. Starting from the essential vocabulary, you'll work through a handful of guided exercises that build a working sense of animation for interfaces, with no prior experience assumed. Expect short, practical lessons rather than a long project, with just enough depth to get you started.

alternates.title: Interaction Design Essentials
alternates.description: Interaction Design Essentials walks you through the basics of interaction design, built for people new to Product Designer work. Starting from the essential vocabulary, you'll work through a handful of guided exercises that build a working sense of interaction design, with no prior experience assumed. Expect short, practical lessons rather than a long project, with just enough depth to get you started.
learning_outcomes: Applying interaction design to a real Product Designer scenario
Practicing interaction design through guided exercises
Building a short interaction design exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

alternates.title: Advanced Interaction Design Techniques
alternates.description: Advanced Interaction Design Techniques goes beyond the basics of interaction design, for people already working toward a Product Designer role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in interaction design and want to go further.
learning_outcomes: Applying interaction design to a real Product Designer scenario
Practicing interaction design through guided exercises
Building a short interaction design exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them
